title: Min Flips to Make Binary String Alternating

monster.name: Chrono Flipping Imp
monster.title: Rotator of Type 1 and Type 2 Flips
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum Type-2 character flips to make string alternating under cyclic shifts!

description: Given a binary string `s`. You are allowed to: 1. Move first character to end. 2. Flip any '0' to '1' or '1' to '0'. Return the minimum number of Type-2 flips to make `s` alternating.
solutionCode:
def minFlipsAlternating(s: str) -> int:
    n = len(s)
    s2 = s + s
    target1 = "01" * n
    target2 = "10" * n
    diff1 = diff2 = 0
    ans = n
    for i in range(2 * n):
        if s2[i] != target1[i]: diff1 += 1
        if s2[i] != target2[i]: diff2 += 1
        if i >= n:
            if s2[i - n] != target1[i - n]: diff1 -= 1
            if s2[i - n] != target2[i - n]: diff2 -= 1
        if i >= n - 1:
            ans = min(ans, diff1, diff2)
    return ans
hints: Double string to s + s to simulate cyclic rotations. Slide a window of length n comparing to "010101..." and "101010...".
